main_text.l: Graves, Exod.17.12. Constr. וְכִבְדֵי לָשׁוֹן Et graves lin-gua, Ezech.3.5.
כבד m. Gravitas, Multitudo, Copia: כבד אכן Gravitas est saxo, Prov.27.3.

כָּבוֹד m. Gloria, Honor: Constr. כְּבוֹד־אַל Gloriam Dei: Aff. אַל־תַּחַד כְּבוֹדִי Ne adunator vel aduneru tu ô gloria mea, Genef.49.v.6. juxta R.Salomonem: si enim persona tertia Verbum explicetur, tùm est discrepantia generis. Hebraï pro Anima accipiunt. Alii pro Lingua, quòd sit Gloriationis instrumentum: & sic Psal.16.9.&30. v.13. & 57.9.
כְּבוּרָה f. Honorata, Psal.45.14. Item, Gravamen, Impedimenta militaria, Jud.8.21.
כְּבָדוּת f. Gravitas: בִּכְבָדוּת Cum gravitate, Graviter, Tardè, Exod.14.25.

נִכְבָּד m. Honoratus, Honorabilis, Gloriofus: Plur. נִכְבָּדִים, & נִכְבָּדִים; Unde Construćtum אֶרֶץ נִכְבְּדֵי Honoratissimi terra, Jes.23.8. נִכְבְּדֵי־מַיִם Gravata aquarum, Copia graves aquarum, Prov.8.24. Aff. נִכְבָּדֵיהֶם Et honoratos eorum, Psal.149.8. וְעַל נִכְבָּדֶיהָ Et super honoratos eius, Nah.3.10. Plur.fœm. נִכְבָּדוֹת מִדְּבַר־דָּךְ Honorificentissima prædicantur de te, Psal.87.3.
כִּבָּה Exstinguí: Præter. כִּבּוּ כַּפִּשְׁתָּה Sicut linum exstincti sunt, Jesa.43.17. Pih.Præt. וְכִבּוּ אֶת־נֵרֹתַי Et exstinguent prunam meam, 2.Sam.14.7.
כָּבַל m. Compes, Psal.105.18. Plur.Constr. בְּכַבְלֵי בַרְזֶל Compedibus ferri, hoc est, ferreis, Psalm.149.8.

כָּבוּל Cabbul, Nomen proprium regionis, 1.Reg.9.13. R.Salomon scribit, sic appellatam suisse, quasi Compeditam, id est, argillaceam, tenacè & infrugiferam. Nam כָּבוּל etiam Talmudicis significat, דְּלָא עָבִיד פֵּירִי quod non profert fru-ctum,

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew forms are read from a small scan and may be imperfect. Doubtful Latin words: "aduneru" (possibly adunerus), "ô" in "tu ô gloria mea". The last word of the final line, "ctum", is read as "ctum" and is doubtful. The first Hebrew phrase of the page (וְכִבְדֵי לָשׁוֹן) and the Hebrew under נִכְבָּד are not fully certain.
